g.text: 1uF each: C9 at VDD_CP pin 20 / GND19; C10 at VDD_A12 / GND13.

g.desc: 1uF each: C9 at VDD_CP pin 20 / GND19; C10 at VDD_A12 / GND13.

g.text: C11 flying capacitor CPP18 to CPN17. C12 from CPVSS15/16 to GND.

g.desc: C11 flying capacitor CPP18 to CPN17. C12 from CPVSS15/16 to GND.

g.text: All are generic non-polar capacitors. Select dielectric, rating and package later.

g.desc: All are generic non-polar capacitors. Select dielectric, rating and package later.

g.text: SUPPLY DECOUPLING / I2C PULL-UPS / DEFAULT MUTE

g.desc: SUPPLY DECOUPLING / I2C PULL-UPS / DEFAULT MUTE

g.text: TI SLOS488F: pin table p4, Figure 45 p24, single-ended inputs p25.

g.desc: TI SLOS488F: pin table p4, Figure 45 p24, single-ended inputs p25.

g.text: Microchip DS70005402H: pin table pp13-15, Figure 3-31 p35,

g.desc: Microchip DS70005402H: pin table pp13-15, Figure 3-31 p35,

g.text: power p38, configuration pp42-45, host UART Figure 6-8 p47.

g.desc: power p38, configuration pp42-45, host UART Figure 6-8 p47.

g.text: 1. BM83 BAT_IN requires 3.2-4.2V. VBAT is the battery rail, not the MCU 3.0V output.

g.desc: 1. BM83 BAT_IN requires 3.2-4.2V. VBAT is the battery rail, not the MCU 3.0V output.

g.text: 2. Configure BM83 for HOST mode and SINGLE-ENDED analog output. Leave AOHPM unused.

g.desc: 2. Configure BM83 for HOST mode and SINGLE-ENDED analog output. Leave AOHPM unused.

g.text: 3. TPA6130A2: I2C address 0x60 (7-bit); firmware must enable stereo outputs and set a safe volume.

g.desc: 3. TPA6130A2: I2C address 0x60 (7-bit); firmware must enable stereo outputs and set a safe volume.

g.text: 4. Input audio feeds LEFTINM / RIGHTINM. Positive inputs are AC-grounded at the source through matching 0.47uF.

g.desc: 4. Input audio feeds LEFTINM / RIGHTINM. Positive inputs are AC-grounded at the source through matching 0.47uF.

g.text: 5. Keep input return paths at the BM83 ground; keep charge-pump loops short and away from audio.

g.desc: 5. Keep input return paths at the BM83 ground; keep charge-pump loops short and away from audio.

g.text: 6. ADAP_IN is left unused: the project already has an external charger. SYS_PWR and VDD_IO are internal-only.

g.desc: 6. ADAP_IN is left unused: the project already has an external charger. SYS_PWR and VDD_IO are internal-only.

g.text: 7. Amplifier uses the RTJ WQFN package; its footprint is assigned and exposed pad 21 is GND.

g.desc: 7. Amplifier uses the RTJ WQFN package; its footprint is assigned and exposed pad 21 is GND.

g.text: 8. Passive parts, connector styles and their footprints are deliberately generic.

g.desc: 8. Passive parts, connector styles and their footprints are deliberately generic.

g.text: PB6 -> I2C1_SCL; PB7 -> I2C1_SDA; PA3 -> AMP_ENABLE

g.desc: PB6 -> I2C1_SCL; PB7 -> I2C1_SDA; PA3 -> AMP_ENABLE

g.text: PA9 -> BM83 RXD; PA10 <- BM83 TXD

g.desc: PA9 -> BM83 RXD; PA10 <- BM83 TXD

g.text: PA4 -> BT_RESET (open drain); PA5 -> BT_WAKE; PA6 <- BT_WAKE_IND

g.desc: PA4 -> BT_RESET (open drain); PA5 -> BT_WAKE; PA6 <- BT_WAKE_IND

g.text: Harness to J6 on Charging and Power. Connect 1 to 1, 2 to 2, 3 to 3.

g.desc: Harness to J6 on Charging and Power. Connect 1 to 1, 2 to 2, 3 to 3.

g.desc: TI typical application adapted for a single-ended source
